host.title: Envoy Address
host.description: IP address or hostname of the Enphase Envoy on your local network (envoy.local)

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: Protocol used to connect to the Envoy

allowInsecureTLS.title: Allow Insecure TLS
allowInsecureTLS.description: Enable this if your Envoy uses a self-signed HTTPS certificate

mode.title: Envoy API Mode
mode.description: Select the Envoy API endpoint to read production data

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often the Envoy is polled for production data

onThresholdW.title: On Threshold (W)
onThresholdW.description: Production level above which the sensor becomes active

offThresholdW.title: Off Threshold (W)
offThresholdW.description: Production level below which the sensor becomes inactive

token.title: Authentication Token
token.description: Bearer token from Enphase Entrez, paste token only without the word Bearer

debugLogging.title: Debug Logging
debugLogging.description: Log production watts on every poll

debugBurstCount.title: Debug Burst Count
debugBurstCount.description: If set, logs the next N polls at INFO level for easier debugging
